items.quote: My wife and I cannot express enough how grateful we are to Yoan and his father for the incredible job they did renovating the floors in our 49-year-old home. This hardworking father-and-son team went above and beyond our expectations.

Justiz Flooring and Bath did an excellent job converting the old spa tub into a walk-in shower. They were timely, efficient with material, clean and professional. They did everything they set out to do with perfection.
Yoan & his partner did an excellent job for my RV. They are punctual, reasonable on the prices and they do excellent work. Good, humble people, I highly recommend them.
